actions.add_site.description: Adds a site to the set of the user's sites in Search Console.
actions.add_site.props.siteUrl.descripti: A URL-prefix property such as "https://www.example.com/" (a missing trailing slash is added) or a domain property such as "sc-domain:example.com".
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_site.description: Removes a site from the set of the user's Search Console sites.
actions.delete_site.props.siteUrl.descri: The Search Console property. Unverified properties are listed too.
actions.delete_site_by_site_url.descript: Removes a property from the user's Search Console sites.
actions.delete_site_by_site_url.props.si: The Search Console property exactly as List Sites returns it: a URL-prefix property ends with "/" (e.g. "https://www.example.com/"), a domain property starts with "sc-domain:" (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com").
actions.delete_sitemap.description: Removes a sitemap from the Sitemaps report of a site.
actions.delete_sitemap.props.feedpath.de: A sitemap submitted to the selected property.
actions.delete_sitemap.props.siteUrl.des: The Search Console property. Only properties you have verified access to are listed.
actions.delete_sitemap_by_site_url.descr: Removes a sitemap from the Sitemaps report of a property.
actions.delete_sitemap_by_site_url.props: The full URL of the sitemap, e.g. "https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml".

The Search Console property exactly as List Sites returns it: a URL-prefix property ends with "/" (e.g. "https://www.example.com/"), a domain property starts with "sc-domain:" (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com").
actions.get_site.description: Gets the permission level of one Search Console property.
actions.get_site.props.site_url.descript: The Search Console property exactly as List Sites returns it: a URL-prefix property ends with "/" (e.g. "https://www.example.com/"), a domain property starts with "sc-domain:" (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com").
actions.get_sitemap.description: Gets the status of one submitted sitemap.
actions.get_sitemap.props.feedpath.descr: The full URL of the sitemap, e.g. "https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml".
actions.get_sitemap.props.site_url.descr: The Search Console property exactly as List Sites returns it: a URL-prefix property ends with "/" (e.g. "https://www.example.com/"), a domain property starts with "sc-domain:" (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com").
actions.inspect_url_by_site_url.descript: Checks the status of one page in Google's index.
actions.inspect_url_by_site_url.props.in: The full URL of the page. It must belong to the property (same protocol and host, under the property path, or any subdomain of a domain property).
actions.inspect_url_by_site_url.props.la: Optional BCP-47 language for issue messages, e.g. "en-US". Defaults to English.
actions.inspect_url_by_site_url.props.si: The Search Console property exactly as List Sites returns it: a URL-prefix property ends with "/" (e.g. "https://www.example.com/"), a domain property starts with "sc-domain:" (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com").
actions.list_sitemaps.description: List all your sitemaps for a given site
actions.list_sitemaps.props.siteUrl.desc: The Search Console property. Only properties you have verified access to are listed.
actions.list_sitemaps.props.sitemapIndex: Optional. The full URL of a sitemap index to list only the sitemaps inside it.
actions.list_sitemaps_by_site_url.descri: Lists the sitemaps submitted for a property.
The Search Console property exactly as List Sites returns it: a URL-prefix property ends with "/" (e.g. "https://www.example.com/"), a domain property starts with "sc-domain:" (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com").
Optional. The full URL of a sitemap index; only the sitemaps inside it are listed.
actions.list_sites.description: Lists the user's Search Console sites.
actions.search_analytics.description: Query traffic data for your site using the Google Search Console API.
actions.search_analytics.props.aggregati: How results are aggregated. Defaults to "auto". "byProperty" cannot be used with the page dimension or a page filter.
actions.search_analytics.props.dataState: Which data to include. "final" (default) has only finalized data; "all" adds fresh, still-changing data from the last days; "hourly_all" is required for the hour dimension and is selected automatically when you group by hour.
actions.search_analytics.props.dimension: The dimensions to group results by, in order. Valid values: "query", "page", "country", "device", "searchAppearance", "date", "hour". Each row of the output gets one column per dimension.
actions.search_analytics.props.endDate.d: Last day of the range (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), in Pacific Time. A range that covers only today or yesterday usually has no data yet.
actions.search_analytics.props.filters.d: Optional filters. All filters are combined with AND.
The maximum number of rows to return, from 1 to 25,000. Defaults to 1,000.
actions.search_analytics.props.searchTyp: The Google surface to report on. Defaults to "web". Discover and Google News have no search queries.
actions.search_analytics.props.siteUrl.d: The Search Console property. Only properties you have verified access to are listed.
actions.search_analytics.props.startDate: First day of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), in Pacific Time. Search Console data lags 2-3 days and is kept for about 16 months.
Zero-based index of the first row to return. Use with Row Limit to page through results. Defaults to 0.
actions.search_analytics_by_site_url.des: Queries search traffic (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) for a property.
actions.search_analytics_by_site_url.pro: How results are aggregated. Defaults to "auto". "byProperty" cannot be used with the page dimension or a page filter.

Which data to include. "final" (default) has only finalized data; "all" adds fresh, still-changing data from the last days; "hourly_all" is required for the hour dimension and is selected automatically when you group by hour.
Group results by these dimensions, in this order. Leave empty for one totals row. "hour" covers only the last few days.
Last day of the range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific Time). Defaults to yesterday when Start Date is set.
Optional filters. All filters are combined with AND.
Number of days ending yesterday (Pacific Time), from 1 to 500. Used when Start Date is empty; defaults to 28. Do not combine with Start Date/End Date.
Maximum rows to return, from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.
The Google surface to report on. Defaults to "web". Discover and Google News have no search queries.

The Search Console property exactly as List Sites returns it: a URL-prefix property ends with "/" (e.g. "https://www.example.com/"), a domain property starts with "sc-domain:" (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com").
First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific Time). Leave empty to use Last N Days.
Zero-based index of the first row; pass next_start_row from the previous call to get the next page. Defaults to 0.
actions.submit_sitemap.description: Submits a sitemap for a site.
actions.submit_sitemap.props.feedpath.de: The full URL of the sitemap, e.g. "https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml".
actions.submit_sitemap.props.siteUrl.des: The Search Console property. Only properties you have verified access to are listed.
actions.submit_sitemap_by_site_url.descr: Submits a sitemap for a property.
actions.submit_sitemap_by_site_url.props: The full URL of the sitemap, e.g. "https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml".

The Search Console property exactly as List Sites returns it: a URL-prefix property ends with "/" (e.g. "https://www.example.com/"), a domain property starts with "sc-domain:" (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com").
actions.urlInspection.description: Use the URL Inspection action to check the status and presence of a specific page within Google's index.
actions.urlInspection.props.languageCode: Optional language for the issue messages, as a BCP-47 code such as "en-US" or "de". Defaults to English.
actions.urlInspection.props.siteUrl.desc: The Search Console property. Only properties you have verified access to are listed.
actions.urlInspection.props.url.descript: The full URL of the page. It must belong to the selected property.
auth.description:
1. Sign in to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/) and create a project, or pick an existing one.
  2. Go to **APIs & Services > Library**, search for **Google Search Console API** and click **Enable**. It must be enabled in the same project as the OAuth client you create below.
  3. Go to **OAuth consent screen**, choose **External**, fill in the app name and the support and developer emails, and save.
  4. In **Scopes** (Data access), add `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters` and `email`, then save.
  5. While the app is in **Testing**, add the Google account you will connect under **Test users**. Tokens of apps in Testing expire after 7 days; publish the app to avoid reconnecting.
  6. Go to **Credentials > Create Credentials > OAuth client ID** and choose **Web application**.
  7. Under **Authorized redirect URIs**, add the Redirect URL shown in this dialog, then click **Create**.
  8. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** into the fields below.
